hypothesis: PRE-REGISTERED (fixed by Osborn on 2026-11-25, before any confirm-set result): the deciding measure is the rise in corpus WER from clean to 10 dB, per language, with a paired 95% bootstrap CI over clips (B=2000, seed 42; scripts/length_check.py --exp EXP-007 --snr 10dB, all clips). Kikuyu is confirmed to lose accuracy faster than a language if its CI lies entirely above that language's CI. EXP-001 found kik +0.128 [0.110, 0.149], swh +0.110 [0.093, 0.129], eng +0.062 [0.052, 0.073]: the expectation is kik > eng confirmed; kik vs swh was not separated before and is not expected to be. Everything else (0 dB, CER, short words, relative WER) is reported descriptively.
description: Confirmation of EXP-001 on FRESH clips (one conceptual change: the clip set). Same system (MMS-1B-all), noise and harness. English: all 199 unused FLEURS en_us test+dev sentences; Kiswahili: all 145 unused FLEURS sw_ke test+dev sentences; Kikuyu: 300 ANV validation (dev) clips from 25 speakers in neither our main set nor ANV train, sentences not in ANV train, at most 12 per speaker. Data choice: Osborn, option 1 (2026-11-25).
